effect_node: Higher risk of later depressive symptoms
source_passage_locator: K058S03: Li et al. → Abstract: Results and Conclusions; full-text Methods: Inclusion criteria and exclusion criteria; Results: prospective risk estimates
review_note: Reviewed K058S02 and K058S03. K058S03 synthesizes 34 prospective cohort studies involving 172077 participants and reports a pooled RR of 2.27 for subsequent depression among individuals with insomnia. Included outcomes encompass depressive symptom scales and diagnosed depression. This supports Insomnia or sleep disruption → Higher risk of later depressive symptoms as RISK_FACTOR_FOR for insomnia specifically. K058S02 provides evidence of bidirectional longitudinal associations but is conservatively classified ASSOCIATED_WITH and excluded from supporting_source_ids. The evidence is observational, heterogeneous and potentially confounded; no causal effect or inevitability is established. AI-assisted review; human confirmation pending.
